nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps VIN_12V down to VCC_5V (5 V logic rail). EN pin tied to enable on power‑up, VIN and GND decoupled externally. This rail powers the 3.3 V LDO, both TMC2209 drivers and any 5 V peripherals.

nodes.name: BOOT
nodes.description: Bootstrap capacitor connection for high-side MOSFET gate drive

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Enable input, active high, <1.25V disables device, float to enable

nodes.name: SS
nodes.description: Soft-start programming pin, external capacitor sets output rise time

nodes.name: VSENSE
nodes.description: Inverting input of transconductance error amplifier, feedback sensing node

nodes.name: COMP
nodes.description: Error amplifier output and PWM comparator input, connect frequency compensation components

nodes.name: PH
nodes.description: Switch node, source of internal high-side power MOSFET

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117‑3.3 LDO lowers VCC_5V to VCC_3V3 for MCU, SPI flash and any 3.3 V logic. VIN pin receives VCC_5V, GND shared. Provides stable 3.3 V rail.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 core. VCC_3V3 supplies core and I/O. UART half‑duplex lines drive each TMC2209 (UART_TMC_A, UART_TMC_B). STEP/DIR/ENN/STDBY outputs control motor stepping per channel. SPI master interface provides flash access (SPI_MOSI, SPI_MISO, SPI_SCK, SPI_CS_FLASH). Boot0 held low for Flash boot.

nodes.name: VBAT
nodes.description: Battery backup power supply for RTC, backup registers and LSE oscillator. Connect to VDD if VBAT not used.

nodes.name: PC13
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: TAMPER-RTC, RTC calibration output. Limited drive capability (2MHz max, sinks/sources up to 3mA).

nodes.name: PC14
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate function: OSC32_IN (32.768kHz LSE crystal input). Limited drive capability.

nodes.name: PC15
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate function: OSC32_OUT (32.768kHz LSE crystal output). Limited drive capability.

nodes.name: OSC_IN
nodes.description: HSE oscillator input (4-16MHz crystal). Can be remapped to PD0 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: OSC_OUT
nodes.description: HSE oscillator output (crystal). Can be remapped to PD1 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: NRST
nodes.description: External reset input, active low with internal pull-up. Filter capacitor to GND recommended.

nodes.name: VSSA
nodes.description: Analog ground reference for ADC, PLL, RC oscillators and comparators.

nodes.name: VDDA
nodes.description: Analog power supply 2.0-3.6V (min 2.4V when ADC used). Also serves as VREF+ on LQFP48 package.

nodes.name: PA0
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: WKUP, USART2_CTS, ADC12_IN0, TIM2_CH1_ETR.

nodes.name: PA1
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: USART2_RTS, ADC12_IN1, TIM2_CH2.

nodes.name: PA2
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: USART2_TX, ADC12_IN2, TIM2_CH3.

nodes.name: PA3
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: USART2_RX, ADC12_IN3, TIM2_CH4.

nodes.name: PA4
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: SPI1_NSS, USART2_CK, ADC12_IN4.

nodes.name: PA6
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: SPI1_MISO, ADC12_IN6, TIM3_CH1.

nodes.name: PA7
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: SPI1_MOSI, ADC12_IN7, TIM3_CH2.

nodes.name: PB2
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate function: BOOT1 configuration pin. Should be pulled low for normal boot from Flash.

nodes.name: PB10
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: I2C2_SCL, USART3_TX, TIM2_CH3.

nodes.name: PB11
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: I2C2_SDA, USART3_RX, TIM2_CH4.

nodes.name: PB12
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: SPI2_NSS, I2C2_SMBAI, USART3_CK, TIM1_BKIN.

nodes.name: PB13
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: SPI2_SCK, USART3_CTS, TIM1_CH1N.

nodes.name: PB14
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: SPI2_MISO, USART3_RTS, TIM1_CH2N.

nodes.name: PB15
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: SPI2_MOSI, TIM1_CH3N.

nodes.name: PA8
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: USART1_CK, TIM1_CH1, MCO.

nodes.name: PA9
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: USART1_TX, TIM1_CH2.

nodes.name: PA10
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: USART1_RX, TIM1_CH3.

nodes.name: PA11
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: USART1_CTS, CAN_RX, TIM1_CH4, USB_DM.

nodes.name: PA12
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: USART1_RTS, CAN_TX, TIM1_ETR, USB_DP.

nodes.name: PA13
nodes.description: GPIO, default function: JTMS/SWDIO (Serial Wire Debug). Do not use as GPIO unless JTAG/SWD is disabled.

nodes.name: PA14
nodes.description: GPIO, default function: JTCK/SWCLK (Serial Wire Debug). Do not use as GPIO unless JTAG/SWD is disabled.

nodes.name: PA15
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), default function: JTDI. Alternate functions: SPI1_NSS (remap), TIM2_CH1_ETR (remap).

nodes.name: PB3
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), default function: JTDO/TRACESWO. Alternate functions: SPI1_SCK (remap), TIM2_CH2 (remap).

nodes.name: PB4
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), default function: NJTRST. Alternate functions: SPI1_MISO (remap), TIM3_CH1 (remap).

nodes.name: PB5
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: I2C1_SMBAI, SPI1_MOSI (remap), TIM3_CH2 (remap).

nodes.name: PB6
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: I2C1_SCL, TIM4_CH1, USART1_TX (remap).

nodes.name: PB7
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: I2C1_SDA, TIM4_CH2, USART1_RX (remap).

nodes.name: BOOT0
nodes.description: Boot mode selection input. Low=boot from Flash, High=boot from System Memory (bootloader) or SRAM depending on BOOT1.

nodes.name: PB8
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: TIM4_CH3, I2C1_SCL (remap), CAN_RX (remap).

nodes.name: PB9
nodes.description: GPIO (5V tolerant), alternate functions: TIM4_CH4, I2C1_SDA (remap), CAN_TX (remap).

nodes.name: driver_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 stepper driver channel A. Powered from VCC_5V. Receives STEP, DIR, ENN, STDBY inputs from MCU. UART_TMC_A is a bi‑directional half‑duplex line for configuration and diagnostics. VS_1/VS_2 connect to VIN_12V externally for motor winding power.

nodes.name: ENN
nodes.description: Enable not input, active high disables power stage

nodes.name: CPI
nodes.description: Charge pump capacitor input, tie to CPO with 22nF capacitor

nodes.name: VCP
nodes.description: Charge pump voltage, tie to VS with 100nF capacitor

nodes.name: SPREAD
nodes.description: Chopper mode selection: Low=StealthChop, High=SpreadCycle, internal pull-down

nodes.name: 5VOUT
nodes.description: Internal 5V regulator output, attach 2.2uF-4.7uF ceramic capacitor to GND

nodes.name: MS1_AD0
nodes.description: Microstep resolution configuration bit 0 / UART address bit 0, internal pull-down

nodes.name: MS2_AD1
nodes.description: Microstep resolution configuration bit 1 / UART address bit 1, internal pull-down

nodes.name: DIAG
nodes.description: Diagnostic and StallGuard output, high level upon stall or error

nodes.name: INDEX
nodes.description: Configurable index output, one pulse per electrical rotation

nodes.name: CLK
nodes.description: External clock input, tie to GND for internal clock

nodes.name: PDN_UART
nodes.description: Power down control input or UART single-wire interface I/O

nodes.name: VCC_IO
nodes.description: 3.3V to 5V IO supply voltage for all digital pins

nodes.name: VREF
nodes.description: Analog reference voltage for current scaling or reference for internal sense resistor mode

nodes.name: DIR
nodes.description: DIR input for step/dir interface, internal pull-down

nodes.name: STDBY
nodes.description: STANDBY input, pull high to disable internal regulator for low power mode, internal pull-down

nodes.name: BRA
nodes.description: Sense resistor connection for coil A, place sense resistor to GND or tie to GND for internal sense mode

nodes.name: NC
nodes.description: Unused pin, may be connected to GND for better PCB routing

nodes.name: BRB
nodes.description: Sense resistor connection for coil B, place sense resistor to GND or tie to GND for internal sense mode

nodes.name: EP
nodes.description: Exposed die pad, must connect to GND plane for thermal and electrical grounding

nodes.name: flash_memory
nodes.description: W25Q64JV SPI NOR flash stores motion parameters. Powered from VCC_3V3. MCU drives CS, MOSI, SCK; flash returns data on MISO. WP tied high for write protection unless software reconfigures.

nodes.name: CS
nodes.description: Chip Select, active low. Pull-up recommended for controlled power-up.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad mode). Tie to VCC for normal operation.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad mode). Tie to VCC for normal operation.
